I'm Heather — I paint with acrylics and I'm building an art business one canvas (and one festival) at a time. This channel is my process: the paintings, the wins and the messes of figuring out the business side, and the parts of my life that shape the work — including the rave scene, which is basically where I go to plug back into the energy I try to put into every piece.

My mission is simple: spread positive energy through art and help raise the vibration of the collective consciousness — one painting, one video, one drop at a time.

New long form videos when I can and new short form videos more often. Shop original paintings and prints :)
